scope: one decoder layer per HF layer kind on a 1x1 Blackhole mesh (one chip of a p300c board)

hf_advertised_context.note: rope_parameters.rope_type is 'default' (theta 1e7); there is no YaRN/NTK scaling factor to reinterpret, so the advertised context is the raw max_position_embeddings.

supported_context.note: FunctionalDecoder.from_state_dict defaults max_seq_len to hf_config.max_position_embeddings and sizes the paged KV cache from the *padded* context; prefill_forward accepts any 1 <= seq_len <= max_seq_len with no divisibility requirement.

open_accuracy_gap.symptom: decode at position 262143 scores PCC 0.550293 against the HF reference (bar 0.995). Prefill at the same context was the same defect and is FIXED (0.983820 -> 0.998817).
open_accuracy_gap.root_cause: ttnn's SDPA kernels keep the flash-attention running max / softmax denominator / output accumulator in Float16_b regardless of fp32_dest_acc_en (sdpa_program_factory.cpp:657, fp32 variant commented out citing tt-metal issue #13364). The denominator is a sum of positive terms, so once the per-chunk contribution falls below bfloat16's half-ULP the denominator stops growing and the normalised output comes out uniformly too large - a pure SCALE error, which PCC cannot see directly but which the layer's residual and o_proj expose.
open_accuracy_gap.prefill_fix: _sdpa_program_config grows the k chunk until at most SDPA_MAX_K_CHUNKS = 512 chunks are merged. Verified: 0.998817 at 262143.
open_accuracy_gap.why_decode_is_not_fixed: paged_scaled_dot_product_attention_decode has the same defect, worse (37.7x scale error at position 262143). An explicit SDPAProgramConfig cures a given position but is only correct when num_k_chunks == 1 or num_k_chunks % (2 * cores_per_head) == 0, and num_k_chunks = ceil((cur_pos+1)/k_chunk) is a RUNTIME quantity while the program config is compile-time. Violations are catastrophic (position 12287 -> 780440x; position 261887 -> NaN). There is no setting that is correct for every position, so no Python-level workaround exists.
open_accuracy_gap.not_a_capability_reduction: The advertised context is not reduced: the layer is constructed at 262144, prefills the full context correctly, and DRAM is not the constraint (31 GiB measured, 1.8 GB used). This is an upstream tt-metal kernel defect, recorded with model-free reproducers.

largest_context_tested.note: prompt 262143 + one decoded token occupy exactly the advertised 262144 positions, so decode runs at the last addressable position; 262143 is divisible by none of the tile (32), page (64), SDPA chunk (256) or prefill chunk (2048)
largest_context_tested.evidence_method: A whole-prompt HF forward is impossible at this length, so the reference is built the only way that stays O(seq_len): linear_attention runs the HF layer in 16384-token segments with a carried DynamicCache (Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet continues exactly from a populated cache), and full_attention builds the K/V cache from k_proj/v_proj + k_norm + RoPE only, validated torch.equal against a genuine short reference_prefill, then runs the real HF layer on the last queries against it. The earlier prefix-consistency check was a tautology - the first outputs of a causal prefill do not depend on the later 250k tokens - and was replaced.

full_attention.verdict: prefill and cache pass the 0.995 bar; decode FAILS - see supported_context.open_accuracy_gap

linear_attention.note: the segmented reference reaches the full context

full_attention.note: prefill now reaches the full advertised context; decode is capped by the upstream decode-SDPA defect

single_shot_reference_limit.reason: cost of a whole-prompt HF forward on the host, not a device limit; beyond these lengths the reference is built segmentally / by projection only

linear_attention_layer.note: gated-delta-net state size is independent of context length

device_capacity.conclusion: The full advertised context fits with ~17x headroom for a single layer at batch 1, so no capability reduction was made or needed at this stage.

batch_contract.prefill: single user per call by construction (chunked paged SDPA requires page-table batch == query batch, and paged_fill_cache addresses one user); batched prefill is a loop over user_id
batch_contract.batch_test: test_batched_users[32-*] with 32 unequal prompt lengths 64..3071, permuted page table
batch_contract.note: Batch 32 was tested at max_seq_len 8192, not at 262144. A batch-32 full_attention layer at 262144 would need 32 * 1.07 GB = 34.4 GB of KV cache, above the 31 GiB measured; that is a batch x context product limit for later stages to schedule, not a reduction of the advertised context, which is tested in full at batch 1.

non_aligned_length_coverage.note: pad_amount_below_one_tile is the regression range for the ttnn.pad aliasing bug (work_log.md 2.1); every length listed here is asserted by a test - 735..768 by test_prefill_decode_pad_below_one_tile, which checks prefill PCC and a following decode step.

hardware.note: two p300c boards of two Blackhole chips each; earlier revisions of this file said p150, which was wrong

fused_decoder.note: The graph-fusing stage changes no capacity-relevant quantity.  Weight and paged-KV dtypes, the cache shape [num_blocks, num_key_value_heads, block_size, head_dim], the block size, the prefill chunk length and the gated-delta-net state shapes are all identical to the functional decoder, so doc/context_contract.json's device_capacity section still applies verbatim.  The advertised 262144-token context was re-constructed, re-prefilled and re-decoded in this stage.

linear_attention.verdict: passes the 0.995 bar, matching the functional decoder to 5e-6

full_attention.verdict: prefill and cache pass; decode fails with the same upstream SDPA-decode kernel defect the functional stage recorded (0.5503 there, 0.5513 here) - see supported_context.open_accuracy_gap, which is unchanged

layout_changes_that_are_not_capacity_cha.rot_mats_width: head_dim (256) instead of rotary_dim (64), in the permuted channel order, with cos=1/sin=0 in the non-rotary channels.  Forced by folding Qwen3.5's partial RoPE into one ttnn.experimental.rotary_embedding_hf; see fused_decoder.rope_channel_permutation and harness.expand_rot_mats.  prefill_forward/decode_forward assert the width.
layout_changes_that_are_not_capacity_cha.paged_k_cache_channel_order: K is stored with permuted head channels (V is not - it never sees RoPE).  FusedDecoder.kv_channel_permutation exposes the permutation; harness.read_paged_kv inverts it, so every cache-vs-HF comparison is against HF's channel order.  Cache shape, dtype and capacity are unchanged.
layout_changes_that_are_not_capacity_cha.l1_residency: The triangular inverse, the per-chunk recurrence loop and the decode RMSNorm now use L1.  Each region estimates its peak live footprint and falls back to DRAM above L1_BUDGET_BYTES (96 MiB of the 110 x 1.43 MiB = 157 MiB a Blackhole worker grid exposes), so a longer chunk degrades to the DRAM path rather than failing to allocate.  DRAM capacity is untouched.
